D&D REST API — Codebase Guide\n\nThis is a small, single-purpose Vite 8 / TypeScript API server for a staged D&D benchmark. It exposes a deterministic REST API backed by a local SQLite file and implements the API as a Vite dev-server middleware plugin.\n\n## Starting and verifying the server\n\n```bash\nPORT=8080 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` installs dependencies if needed and then launches Vite in the foreground, bound to `127.0.0.1` on the port given by the `PORT` environment variable. Quick health checks:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/health\n# → {\"ok\":true}\n\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/v1/storage/status\n# → {\"driver\":\"sqlite\",\"schema_version\":1,\"initialized\":true}\n```\n\nStop the server with `Ctrl-C` in the terminal where it is running.\n\n## Entry point and major modules\n\n| File / directory | Responsibility |\n| ---------------- | -------------- |\n| `./run.sh` | Shell entry point. Ensures `npm install` has run and starts Vite. |\n| `vite.config.ts` | Minimal Vite configuration. Imports the D&D API plugin and registers it. |\n| `src/lib/plugin.ts` | Vite plugin that installs the API middleware and initializes the database on server start. |\n| `src/lib/router.ts` | Central request router. Matches HTTP method and URL, then delegates to domain handlers in the exact historical order. |\n| `src/lib/http.ts` | Low-level helpers: `readBody` and `sendJson`. |\n| `src/lib/validation.ts` | Reusable type guards: `isNonEmptyString`, `isLevel`, `isAbilityScore`, etc. |\n| `src/lib/auth.ts` | `scrypt`-based password hashing and verification. |\n| `src/lib/rules.ts` | Pure, deterministic D&D rule calculations (ability modifiers, proficiency, dice, initiative, encounter XP). |\n| `src/lib/db.ts` | All SQLite access: schema creation, CRUD for every domain, and JSON serialization/deserialization. |\n| `src/lib/handlers/*.ts` | One handler file per domain: `health`, `storage`, `campaigns`, `compendium`, `auth`, `dice`, `encounters`, `combat`, `characters`, `dmTools`, `phb`. |\n| `src/lib/constants.ts` | Deterministic reference tables (`XP_TABLE`, `LEVEL3_THRESHOLDS`, `DIFFICULTY_RECOMMENDATION`). |\n| `src/lib/types.ts` | Domain TypeScript interfaces. |\n| `src/main.ts` | Client-side entry point (currently just a log statement). This makes the server deterministic and easy to restart.\n\n### Request routing\n\n1. The Vite plugin (`src/lib/plugin.ts`) adds a Connect-style middleware to the dev server.\n2. The middleware calls `route(req, res, next)`.\n3. `router.ts` parses the URL, checks the HTTP method, and dispatches to a handler.\n4. If a handler matches, it writes a JSON response and returns `true`; otherwise the router falls through to `next()` so Vite can serve static assets or the client entry point.\n5. Unhandled exceptions in the middleware are caught and returned as `500 {\"error\":\"internal server error\"}` if headers have not been sent yet.\n\n### POST body parsing\n\nPOST requests are read once from the stream and parsed as JSON. Malformed JSON returns `400 {\"error\":\"invalid json\"}` before any handler runs. Empty bodies are treated as `undefined`.\n\n## Main API / domain groupings\n\n| Group | Endpoints | Notes |\n| ----- | --------- | ----- |\n| Health | `GET /health` | Liveness probe. |\n| Storage | `GET /v1/storage/status`, `POST /v1/storage/reset` | Reports SQLite status and can reset the schema. |\n| Auth | `POST /v1/auth/register`, `POST /v1/auth/login` | Username/password registration; deterministic `session-<username>` token on login. |\n| Campaigns | `POST /v1/campaigns`, `GET /v1/campaigns/:id/state`, `POST /v1/campaigns/:id/characters`, `POST /v1/campaigns/:id/events` | Campaigns, characters, and event logs. |\n| Compendium | `POST /v1/compendium/monsters`, `GET /v1/compendium/monsters/:slug`, `POST /v1/compendium/items`, `GET /v1/compendium/items/:slug` | Bestiary and item references. |\n| Combat | `POST /v1/combat/sessions`, `POST /v1/combat/sessions/:id/conditions`, `POST /v1/combat/sessions/:id/advance` | Initiative order, conditions, and turn advancement.
